notable_absence.finding: The `similarity` property table states 'It's recommended to choose the same similarity metric for your Search index as the one used in your embedding model' for dot_product/l2_norm/cosine, but never states what similarity metric a vector field defaults to if the property is omitted entirely - unlike default_analyzer ('standard') and default_datetime_parser ('dateTimeOptional'), which this same page gives explicit defaults for. This is a real gap for anyone building a vector field definition from this page alone.

cross_component_finding: The vector child-field type documented here (type: vector / vector_base64, with similarity and vector_index_optimized_for properties) is a FIELD-LEVEL option inside an ordinary Search index's type mapping, usable alongside text/number/boolean/geopoint fields in the same document - not the same thing as a whole Search Vector Index (index-type:search-vector, built and managed by the Index Service axis this round's registry state explicitly warns against conflating with search:full-text-index content). This page's own vector properties feed search-request-params.md's knn object and run-searches.md's hybrid tf-idf/bm25 scoring calculation directly (via the dims/similarity properties cross-referenced from both pages), making this genuinely a bridge between the mapping/analyzer half of the Search module and the query/scoring half - both firmly on the fts:full-text-search side, never the vector-index side.
cross_product_finding: This page's twin, cloud/search/search-index-params.json, was left UNMEASURED before this round's dispatch (the diff timed out on this file's size) and its extraction record contains only 7 concepts covering Initial Settings, planParams, doc_config, doc_filter, doc-config-mode-enum, and scoring_model - i.e. everything up through the start of the mapping object. Having now read this server/8.0 page in full (1566 lines vs. a much shorter Capella record), the real similarity is LOW, not the 'near-duplicate' pattern seen on about-mappings.md (0.96) or even the mid-range create-search-index-alias.md (0.80): everything past the initial doc_config/scoring_model section - the entire Analyzers/Char_filters/Tokenizers/Token_filters/Token_maps/Date_time_parsers/Synonym_sources breakdown, the Default_mapping and Types/{scope}.{collection}/{field_name}/Fields-array objects (including the full vector-field property set: dims, similarity, vector_index_optimized_for), and the Store/ScorchPersisterOptions/ScorchMergePlanOptions performance-tuning objects - has NO counterpart anywhere in the Capella extraction. That is the majority of this page's content and concept yield. The size-driven diff timeout was not a fluke of tooling; it reflects a real, large content gap between the two products' documented JSON schemas, not two pages that happen to be hard to diff.
